policy_score: current coarse one-hour group variance per household
random_match: same hard acquisition budget k*ceil(N/16)*24 household-interval opportunities; balanced groups differ by at most one household; report actual valid rows and file bytes
window_boundary: rebuild with fixed zero-mean training prior; evidence outside window intentionally excluded

success_conditions.exactness: all same-evidence checks within frozen tolerances
success_conditions.resource: measured reduction in resident detail or central data access, with all retained summaries charged
success_conditions.policy: report paired descriptive loss and access; no significance or superiority threshold invented after scoring
success_conditions.novelty: no new Gaussian elimination theorem; empirical distinction must survive incremental baseline
